newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas up in winter again as contango widens.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas up in winter again as contango widens.

text.p: IPE natural gas prices on Wednesday continued to firm once again in the winter, with January and February both trading 0.10 pence a therm above the previous day's settlement price.
January saw 50 lots traded at up to 18.50 pence a therm, while 50 lots also traded in February at up to 18.525 pence. A total of 125 lots were traded in 5 separate deals.

The strength in the winter has steepened the contango from autumn to winter still further. October traded at 11.025 pence on Wednesday morning, so a differential of 7.475 pence a therm has appeared in the short period between October and January.
The autumn/winter differential has been widening for several days, and some futures brokers and physical traders have said the market is due for a correction.
